prompt: Review the authoring quality of my pdf-splitter skill.
setup: The pdf-splitter skill exists at a repository-local load path.
The evalkit plugin's bundled skill-reviewer agent is not loaded (plugin not enabled or not reloaded).
expected: The missing skill-reviewer agent is reported, instructing to install evalkit and run /reload-plugins.
The run stops rather than degrading to an ad-hoc review.
